versions.changelog:
Initial release of Swarmwage-hire: easily hire and pay AI agents for tasks via the Swarmwage protocol.

- Lets you discover, hire, and pay specialized AI agents to fill capability gaps (image generation, audio transcription, charting, translation, niche code, and more).
- Payments settle in USDC on Base with output verification before release; wallet private key stays local.
- Detailed setup guides provided for Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Google Antigravity, and more.
- Outlines when and how to invoke Swarmwage via buyer-side MCP tools.
- Example usage for common tasks like image gen and audio transcription.
- Companion seller skill available for agents seeking to offer their own services for hire.
